title: Cecil Grimes Health Inspection

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: You the owner of this... establishment? And I am applying the absolute barest definition of the word.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You the owner of this... establishment? And I am applying the absolute barest definition of the word.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: It's not like clandestine language or anything. You've got a barely running shop here. And that's before I get involved.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's not like clandestine language or anything. You've got a barely running shop here. And that's before I get involved.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: I'm Cecil Grimes and boy do we need to have some words.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm Cecil Grimes and boy do we need to have some words.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Once an infraction's been noted, it's as good as logged. You'll barely notice the dock coming out of next month's return. Now, anyways, for why I'm really here...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Once an infraction's been noted, it's as good as logged. You'll barely notice the dock coming out of next month's return. Now, anyways, for why I'm really here...

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Well, considering you've got plates filthier than the bottom of my HOVA? Yes, I'd say there's always more. We'll add a 73C infraction for that one. Anything else?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, considering you've got plates filthier than the bottom of my HOVA? Yes, I'd say there's always more. We'll add a 73C infraction for that one. Anything else?

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Somehow, some way, I'm sure I'll recover. The important thing is that I'm an Assistant Sub-Deputy Hygiene Inspector at CorpSec's Bureau of Sanitation.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Somehow, some way, I'm sure I'll recover. The important thing is that I'm an Assistant Sub-Deputy Hygiene Inspector at CorpSec's Bureau of Sanitation.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: At this point? The inquiry's over. You can lodge a complaint with the head office but, I promise you, it will go unanswered. Feel free to pay the messaging fee though. My next holiday in the Spire ain't gonna pay for itself.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: At this point? The inquiry's over. You can lodge a complaint with the head office but, I promise you, it will go unanswered. Feel free to pay the messaging fee though. My next holiday in the Spire ain't gonna pay for itself.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: Those grease stains you have on the counter? That's a 14FC. Over there? That jar of unidentified matter? That's an infraction of Code 92B. I don't think I need to tell you they get pricier as the number rises.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Those grease stains you have on the counter? That's a 14FC. Over there? That jar of unidentified matter? That's an infraction of Code 92B. I don't think I need to tell you they get pricier as the number rises.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: All that said, I'd like to introduce you to my friend Mica, she is waiting for you downstairs. I'd say it's been a pleasure but, you know... it hasn't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All that said, I'd like to introduce you to my friend Mica, she is waiting for you downstairs. I'd say it's been a pleasure but, you know... it hasn't.

nodes.speaker: Cecil Grimes
nodes.text: My colleague. Mica deals with the most serious offenders. So, uh... good luck!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My colleague. Mica deals with the most serious offenders. So, uh... good luck!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Excuse me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I am. Can I help you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am. Can I help you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I am. Can I help you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I am. Can I help you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The fuck does that mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The fuck does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Who are you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Unidentified matter?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Unidentified matter?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't know a Cecil Grimes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't know a Cecil Grimes.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't know a Cecil Grimes.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't know a Cecil Grimes.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: There's more?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's more?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How is that fair?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How is that fair?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No, sir.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, sir.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All set.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All set.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Wait, whoa, can we slow down here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Wait, whoa, can we slow down here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Wait, whoa, can we slow down here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Wait, whoa, can we slow down here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Okay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like the peak of middle management.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like the peak of middle management.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like the peak of middle management.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like the peak of middle management.
